title: What Would You Do? Bike Theft (White Guy, Black Guy, Pretty Girl)
summary: A hidden-camera social experiment in a park where three people try to steal a bike in the open: a white teenager, a black teenager and a young woman. It records how bystanders react to each.
why: Used in threads on bias and social engineering as a vivid example of how bystanders treat different thieves.

quote.text: There's an awesome video of three college-student-aged in a park.
